༄༅// gser chos lugs kyi seng ge'i gdong can sngon mo'i gtor bzlog gi phrin las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ye shes 'jig rten rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// ji snyed dbang gi 'khor los sgyur ba mo// rgyal ba kun yum seng ge'i gdong can ma// tha dad min pa dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// brda 'gyur gnyis su smra dbang ba ri bas// ye shes mkha' 'gro las nos gsang ba'i sngags// bklags pas grub pa'i gdams pa sa skya pa'i// thugs gsang dpal be'ur 'khyil ba'i gser gyi chos// gang gi rnal 'byor la brten rang gzhan dag /bsrung bskyab rdo rje'i rwa bar gnas bcas te// pha rol gyis brtsams byad gtad mi mthun phyogs// phyir bzlog drag po gtor ma'i las rim brtsams// 'dir bla ma rdo rje gdan pas ba ri lo tsā ba la gnang ba dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi ya gyal du gyur pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can ma 'di la/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang*/ las tshogs gdams ngag sogs rgyas par bzhugs mod/ bskang ba mdos zor la sogs pa rgyas par ma mngon yang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i gsung las/ gsang sngags rnying mar de dag rgyas par mchis pa'i lugs srol gyi rgyas bkab lag len du dril ba ni/ de ltar sbyar ba mi rung ba med par man ngag dang phyag len rnam dag yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rje tshar chen rin po che sogs bla ma gong mas mdzad pa mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir mkhan chen ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rjes sgrub thabs mchod phreng*/ bstod bskul/ bzlog pa'i rim par stsal ba/ de nyid slar yang de dag gi yan lag rnams yongs su ma rdzogs par don du gnyer ba dag gi ngor 'don chog khrigs chags su bstar ba la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ sbyor bar rten bshams mchod gtor dang*// bskang gtor maṇḍal gtor ma zor// drag mchod sman phud rakta tshogs// ling phur nang mchod rol mo bsham// zhes pa ltar/

gnas khang byi dor byas par 'di'i bris sku rab gnas can zhal lhor phyogs par bkram pa'i mdun du gtor ma smug rtsis byugs pa dang*/ bskang gtor che ba stod zur gsum smad zlum po la rtse rgyan ci mdzes byas pa'i mtheb kyus bskor ba de'i mthar nyer spyod sbreng tshar du bshams/ de'i mdun phyogs kyi sa gzhi la stegs bu byas pa la thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab nas che chung ji ltar rigs pa'i tshad kyis re khā gru bzhi/ byang ngos kyi thig nang ma dang tshangs thig 'dzom pa nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sleb pa'i srad bus byang shar dang*/ nub byang gi zur thig thal nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus phyogs la nye ba'i ji tsam sleb pa'i sar bya rjes bya/ tshad de nyid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas de'i lan bya/ bya rjes gnyis kyi bar dang lho ngos kyi re khā nang ma dang tshangs thig 'dzom pa gsum gru gsum du gdab/ tshul de nyid kyis re khā phyi ma nas chos 'byung gi phyi rol du me ri gru gsum gdab/ de'i dbus su padma dang 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma bzhi la nyi gdan gyi steng du dbus su tshon spungs sngon po/ phyogs bzhir shar nas g.yas skor du dkar ser dmar ljang gi mtshan ma dgod/ de'i steng du lcags kyi rkang gsum gyi khar lcags slong gi nang du dgra bgegs kyi shog ling yod na bltab pa'i steng du/ nas nag rjen btags byas pa khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma gru gsum che ba gcig la de'i sum gnyis tsam du sleb pa'i gru gsum bzhis bskor ba sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i mthar zan gyi mu khyud kyi rnam pas khor yug tu bskor ba la/ skyer pa sogs dug shing gi rtsang thur drug cu rtsa bzhi/ dug khrag dang ro sol gyis dmar nag tu byugs pa srin mo 'gros su btsugs/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du snyug sdong gtor ma las cung zad mtho bar btsugs pa'i rtser bag zan gyis mi mgo skam po'i rnam pa khrag gis kha mig dod pas mtshan pa/

de la brten nas rgyu ma rlon pa rlung gis bus pa'i lda ldi bre/ gtor ma rnams la rtsang thur gyi rtser sha sna snying sna'i tshal bu dang*/ mkha' 'gro gtso 'khor rnams kyi tsa ka li rab gnas can dang*/ dar nag gi ba dan gyis brgyan/ de'i mdun du gtor zor gru gsum khrag gis byugs par skyer rtsang btsugs pa dang*/ lcags phye zangs phye zi ra yungs kar sogs thun rdzas/ mtshe'i sdong po/ yungs kar gyi gong bu/ rdo zor gru gsum pa/ mda' gzhu/ khrag sna dug sna rnams bsham/ gzhan yang khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog sogs drag po'i nyer spyod rnams dang*/ gtor ma'i mdun du lcags snod kyi nang du tsha ba gsum ske tshe gri khrag la sogs pa bsres pa'i bsgral bya zan gyi liṅga'ang spyi ltar byas pa khebs bcas bsham/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ rnga dung*/ rkang gling rol mo la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la/ dngos gzhir bdag 1 bskyed gtor 'bul bcas// mdun 2 bskyed sgrub mcha 3 ོda bshags 4 bzla 5 sa bya// bsgral las byas te bzlog 7 bsgyur bcol// zor bsku 8 la dgra phyogs zor du 'phang*// zhes pa ltar/ dang po la sngon 'gro gtor ma gcig chus bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba bi ghnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐ bka' gsang rmad byung dkyil 'khor 'dir// gsang ba'i dam can so so dang*// 'du ba'i lha rnams ma gtogs pa'i// bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyis la// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du song*// ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// seng gdong drag mor khros nas ni// khyed cag lus ngag yid gsum rnams// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur// de bas rang rang gnas su dengs// oṃ sarba bighnān gatstsha/

rol mo dang bcas te aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥsogs rtsa sngags brjod cing bgegs bskrad/ mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐ nga ni seng gdong drag mo ste// sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul las// ye shes khro mos nam mkha' gang*// dam tshig mkha' 'gros bar snang gang*// las byed mkha' 'gros sa gzhi gang*// phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i rwa gur brtsegs// me rlung 'tshub mas snang srid 'gengs// bgegs rigs 'jug pa'i skabs med do// zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas rtsa sngags kyi rjes su oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing mtshams bcad do// mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ gyis chos rnams stong par gyur pa'i ngang*// āḥlas dung chen thod pa yangs pa'i nang*// hūm̐ las phyi nang dgra bgegs bsgral byung gi /khrag zhag yon chab dbang lnga'i me tog dang*// tshil chen spos dang zhun chen mar me gsal// mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas ri// rkang gling rnga dung rol mo bsam mi khyab// bdud rtsi sman mchog rakta'i rgya mtsho che// sha rus brtsegs pa'i gtor ma 'dod yon lnga// dpag yas mchod sprin zhing kun khyab par gyur// oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis nyer spyod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes pas bdud rtsi dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes pas rakta dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta ba la ba ti guhya siddhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes pas gtor ma dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa swā hā/ zhes pas mchod pa thams cad mi zad par byin gyis brlab bo// bdag bskyed dngos la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa spyi ltar bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu sogs kyis tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs so// oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs so// stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de yongs su gyur pa las 'og tu 'bar zhing bzod par dka' ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rab tu brtan pa/ phyogs kun tu bar mtshams med cing dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng du sra zhing mkhregs pa'i rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du rdo rje'i bla res brgyan pa/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me dpung drag tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sha za dang ma mo mkha' 'gro/ ro dang ro langs la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod chen po 'jigs shing skye g.ya' bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gdeng kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i dbus kyi nam mkhar pam̐ las sna tshogs padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag gsal zhing 'tsher ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ sku mdong mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ seng zhal rab tu rngam pa ches cher gdangs shing*/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs nas ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ me'i phung po 'bar ba lta bu'i spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dang ag tshom dmar ser gyen thur du 'khyil pa las me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas pas rno zhing gcod pa'i ngar dang ldan pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa dkar po khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo na rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i kha ḍāṃ ga bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po mche ba gtsigs pa lngas dbu la brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/

nu 'bur mtho zhing rab tu rgyas pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa dang bcas pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brla la g.yas bskum pa'i brang ba gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis dgra bgegs thams cad kyi ngo bo mi ro dmar seng dbugs bral ma thag pa'i mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa gan rgyal du 'gyel ba'i snying gar brdzis pa/ drag mo shin tu khros pa'i tshul can/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang de dag gi 'khor du ye shes dang 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min mkha' spyod au ḍyān la sogs pa'i gnas nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis sngar bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/

oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i zhal can ma// mthon mthing 'od stong 'phro ba'i mig yangs ma// dpa' mo dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs cher sgrogs ma// ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod cing*/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du mnyam par gzhag go /de las ldang ba na bzlas pa bya ste/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag sngags kyi phreng bas g.yon du bskor ba las 'od zer me dpung lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab/ nad gdon sdig sgrib byad kha rbod gtong*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad reg pa tsam gyis tshar bcad/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces pa'i bsnyen sngags ci nus bzlas la/ mthar sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ gzhan gyi byad kha rbod gtong thams cad phyir bzlog pa dang*/ myur du mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can ma'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa 'dod don gsol ba btab/ bzlog pa byed na/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥsogs dang lha srin sde brgyad mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byed kha rbod gtong thams cad byad ma gnod byed kyi steng du e sa bhyoḥbhyoḥbazlog bzlog ces btags pa'am/ yang na sngags mgo mjug bzlog la bzlas na'ang bzlog par 'gyur te/ mthar/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can du bsgoms pa'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/

g.yon pa'i mthil zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams pa'i bar du dgra bgegs dmigs la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub mor brtsams pa/ rmi lam ngan pa mtshan ltas ngan pa dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur pa de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o// ngag bcing bar bgyi'o// yid bcing bar bgyi'o// mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ces dang*/ thal mo lan gsum gsum brdabs/ de 'dra lan gcig gam gsum gyi mthar/ rtsa sngags la tri ra tsa sa ma ya byad ma'i srog la gtubs/ zhes btags pa cung zad bzlas la/ khro mo 'bar ba'i sogs brjod la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ de nas mdun bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na der 'jug cing*/ de dang ma 'brel na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/seng ge'i gdong can 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam byas la/ rang nyid srung 'khor gyi nang du lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam rnams bya'o// gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma dang mdun gyi nang mchod gnyis kar dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ sum̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ de rnams la bhrūm̐ ām̐ dzṝm̐ kham̐ hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu ba'i khu ba dmar po tsha ba la/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dkar po bsil ba blugs pas dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis lhan cig byin brlab/ gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las sna tshogs padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag gsal zhing 'tsher ba zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ dus gzhan du de tsam mi nus na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' spyod la sogs pa'i gnas nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa tsam byas kyang rung*/ gong ltar yang mdun bskyed kyi lha'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i 'od kyis gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa gsum mam lnga la sogs pas phul/ gong ltar mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ o ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/

sngar gyi bstod pa bsdus pa'am/ spro na/ a ho bde gshegs kun gyi dpal mo che// ka pā la bkang dmar chen lus 'tsho zhing*// sa gsum 'byung po skrag mdzad gri gug 'phyar// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod la 'dud// rwa ba'i sbub kyi mun chen ltar gnag sku// tsa muṇḍi sogs ma mo'i dkyil 'khor du// sha khrag pha rol byad ma gsod la dgyes// da mu'i 'tshe ba bzlog mdzad khyod la 'dud// ra wi padmar gar mdzad drag chen mo// sa chen 'dar ba'i sgra 'byin seng ge'i zhal// ma lus chos skus khyab pa'i a yig ge /rwa bar bzhugs pa'i rngam brjid khyod la 'dud// ya bral dus mtshan dmag dpung rab bkye la// phaṭa phaṭa sgra sgrogs byad ma'i snying khrag 'thung*// gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du brlag tu gsol// zhes pa phyir bzlog yi ge bcu bzhi dang sbyar ba'i bstod pa chag lo rin chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pas bstod do// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng ge'i gdong can ma// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// skyabs su song ba'i rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams// nam yang g.yel med rtag tu skyong bar mdzod// khyed thugs dgyes pa'i chu skyes las byung ba'i// dngos grub bde chen bdud rtsi'i bcud chen pos// ltos bcas bung ba bdag cag tshim mdzad de// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid du gsol// zhes pas phrin las bcol te 'dod don gsol lo// gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis mdun gyi maṇḍal gtor ma dang bcas pa la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas 'thor zhing*/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma sogs nas chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gdeng kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i dbus kyi nam mkhar pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma bzhi la ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du hūm̐ yig re re/

de'ang dbus kyi mthing nag shar gyi dkar po/ lho'i ser po/ nub kyi dmar po/ byang gi ljang gu rnams gsal zhing 'tsher ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcad/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas hūm̐ rnams la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mthing nag shar du sangs rgyas rigs kyi seng gdong can dkar mo/ lhor rin chen rigs kyi seng gdong can ser mo/ nub tu padma'i rigs kyis seng gdong can dmar mo/ byang du las kyi rigs kyi seng gdong ma ljang gu thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sogs nas/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rno zhing gcod pa'i ngar dang ldan pa'i rang rtags kyis mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyi thod pa dkar po khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa'i sogs nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang de dag gi 'khor du ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rnga dung rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan 'dren pa ni 'di skad do// hūm̐ bhyoḥ gnas mchog 'og min stug po bkod// mkha' la spyod dang au ḍa yān// so sa gling sogs gar bzhugs nas// mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo 'khor bcas gshegs// e dbyings gru gsum mthing nag 'bar// 'jigs rung ya nga'i dur khrod dbus// pad nyi ro yi gdan steng nas// ye shes mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhengs// me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i klong*// rlung nag dud sprin 'tshub ma'i nang*// skye med dbyings las skye ba'i 'phrul// mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo sku bzhengs shig

/dad dang dam tshig ldan pa yi// rnal 'byor sgrub po bdag cag gis// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don slad du// yum chen mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no// bskal ba grangs med sngon rol nas// 'gro ba'i don du thugs bskyed pa'i// 'bras bu mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir// thugs rje dgongs la gshegs su gsol// khyed kyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i don// gdug pa 'dul phyir skur sprul ma// de yi thugs dam bdag bskul na// dus la bab po da tshur spyon// ye shes mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso// seng ge'i gdong can gshegs su gsol// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rngam pa'i zhal ldan gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas rin chen padma dang*// las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas// gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol// oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ hūm̐ ye shes las grub dag pa'i gzhal med khang*// gru gsum mthing nag pad nyi ro yi gdan// me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā sa na tiṣṭhantu/ zhes pas bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas mdun bskyed la bstim/ dbang lha gong bzhin spyan drangs/ mchod de dbang bskur nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo'i spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ gzhan rnams kyi spyi bor rigs gzhan bzhi'i 'khor lo rin po che padma ral gri rnams kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba la/ mchod pa'i dngos po mi zad par spel ba ni/ rgyal kun sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin stobs dang*// bdag cag lhag bsam smon lam bden stobs kyis// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bskal pa'i bar// mchod yul kun gyi spyan lam rgyas gyur cig

/oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarb+ba pū dza megha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa swā hā/ zhes pas rgya cher spel/ hūm̐ rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// ngo bo rdul bral ye shes rang snang sprin// mchod yon me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bul// oṃ ḍākki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nyer spyod 'bul/ hūm̐ rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mchog /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang yi ge lnga// dbyer med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul// oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas sman dang*/ spro na 'og nas 'byung ba'i phud mchod kyis kyang mchod do// hūm̐ phyi nang gsang ba'i kun rtog dgra tshogs rnams// skye med ye shes chen po'i klong yangs su// bsgral ba las byung rakta'i rgya mtsho che// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul// oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas rakta 'bul/ hūm̐ srid gsum rnam par dag pa'i gtor gzhong du// 'khor ba yongs sgrol dmar gyi gtor ma bsham// myang 'das ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid// sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lngar byin brlabs// ro bcud brgya ldan sha khrag rgyan dang ldan// ma mo mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i dam rdzas 'di// seng ge'i gdong can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// 'khor bcas mnyes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ ḍā ki ni singha mu khi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtor sngags lan gsum dang*/ shes shing nus na mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor sngags kyang brjod pas gtor ma phul la/ spro na bstod pa rgyas pa mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba'i/

gang la bstod cing sogs kyis bstod/ mi nus na/ hūm̐ zhe sdang rnam dag rnam shes gnas gyur pa// chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// thugs kyi rigs mchog mthing nag khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gti mug rnam dag gzugs phung gnas gyur pa// me long ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// sku yi rigs mchog rab dkar khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ser sna'i rang bzhin tshor phur gnas gyur pa// mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// yon tan rigs mchog gser 'dra khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod chags rnam dag 'du shes gnas gyur pa// sor rtog ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// gsung gi rigs mchog rab dmar khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phrag dog rnam dag 'du byed gnas gyur pa// bya grub ye shes rang bzhin bcom ldan ma// phrin las rigs mchog ljang sngon khro mo'i sku// seng ge'i gdong can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pas mchod pa'o// tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ yo byad rnams 'du byas la 'og nas 'byung ba ltar 'bul/ de nas thugs dam bskang ba la ni/ thog mar bskang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ chos dbyings rnam dag cir yang rung ba la// sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs pa 'di// dngos su bshams dang rnal 'byor yid kyis sprul// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs// bden tshig smon lam dag pa'i nus mthu yis// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur// spros med ngang las spros pa'i tshogs snang ba// mkha' dang sa gzhi khyab par 'byung gyur cig /oṃ sarb+ba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta ya a brta ya hoḥzhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ bskang gtor la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas la/

gtor sngags lan gsum gyis dbul zhing*/ hūm̐ skye med rnam dag chos sku'i ngang nyid las// skye ba'i cho 'phrul gzugs kyi skur bstan ma// seng ge'i gdong can 'khor dang bcas pa la// bdag gis mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni// gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i mchod yon dang*// dri zhim zhabs bsil khrus kyi zhal bsil dang*// dbyibs legs kha dog phun tshogs me tog gsar// dri bzang dud pa'i sprin gyi bdug spos dang*// mkha' la nyi bzhin gsal ba'i mar me'i phreng*// bsil dang yid du 'ong ba'i dri mchog dang*// kha dog dri ro nus ldan zhal zas tshogs// rol mo'i bye brag snyan brjid yid 'khul ba// sa dang nam mkha' bar snang khyab pa 'di// mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can la 'bul// gtso mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur nas// rnal 'byor bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog pa dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'di dang skye ba kun du bskyab mdzad nas// gnod pa'i lam spangs yang dag don rtogs mdzod// thod mkhar 'bar ba g.yang gzhi'i bla re bres// snying dang glo mchin 'phyang 'phrul sna tshogs pa// rgyu rlon lda ldi phyogs kun khyab par dpyangs// khrag zhag 'khyil ba'i gzhi la keng rus bkram// mi mgo'i tog dang zhing gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar// drag po'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid ldan pa'i nang*// dgra bgegs sha khrag dron mo'i mchod yon bskyil// mig rna sna lce snying rnams drod ma yal// dbang po lnga yi me tog gsar pa bshams// dur khrod mes bsregs tshil chen spos dud 'khrigs// zhun chen rab tu gsal ba'i sgron me sbar// mkhris chen khrag gis sbags pa'i dri mchog dang*// sha khrag rus pa nang khrol zhal zas tshogs// mi rkang gling bu thod pa ltag sprod rnga// byad ma dam nyams 'gugs pa'i drag po'i dbyangs// sod cig sgrol cig zhes bskul drag po'i ngag

/ye shes mkha' 'gro dgyes pa bskyed pa yi// gsang ba'i dam rdzas sngangs skrag bskyed pa 'di// seng gdong rngam pa'i mkha' 'gro khyod la 'bul// 'khor bcas dgyes shing thugs dam gnyen bskul nas// rnal 'byor bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad bsad pa'i las// gang yin byad mkhan rang la bzlog nas kyang*// bdag sogs srung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod// gzhan yang mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i dam rdzas ni// yid 'ong gzugs dang rna bar snyan pa'i sgra// ngad ldan dri dang bde bar 'tsho ba'i ro// bde chen bskyed pa reg bya'i mchod pa 'bul// g.yul las rgyal byed 'khor lo nor bu dang*// btsun mo blon po glang po rta yi mchog /dmag dpon rin chen rnam pa bdun dang ni// mda' mdung ral gri mtshon cha ngar ldan sogs// gri gug thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ ga la sogs// byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'bul// rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan cha dang*// mi mgo skam rlon phreng dang dar dpyangs dang*// mi lpags stag lpags la sogs sku yi chas// rnga dang sil snyan dbyangs sogs gsung gi rdzas// rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan la sogs thugs mnyes byed// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgyes par bskyed phyir 'bul// ri rab gling bzhi gling phran rol mtshor bcas// lha mi'i longs spyod kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par 'os pa ji snyed mchis pa yang*// dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te 'bul lags na// bzhes nas bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// mi dang mi min gnod pa zhi ba dang*// thar pa'i lam brnyes byang chub thob par mdzod// dbang bzhi'i chu bo ma nub dam tshig dang*// zab gsal bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom// snying po'i sngags bzlas las bzhi'i phrin las kyis// sems can don byed las kyi tshogs la 'bad// kun kyang yang dag lta bas brgyan pa yi// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur cig

/hūm̐ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed mdzad yum// seng gdong chos kyi sku yi thugs dam bskang*// sa bcu'i byang sems kun la dbang bsgyur ma// seng gdong longs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs dam bskang*// gang la gang 'dul de de'i skur ston ma// seng gdong sprul pa'i sku yi thugs dam bskang*// sku gsum dbyer med mkha' khyab 'dus ma khyab// seng gdong ngo bo nyid sku'i thugs dam bskang*// bstan pa bsrung zhing dgra bgegs tshar gcod phyir// rdo rje rigs kyi seng gdong thugs dam bskang*// nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba'i phyir// bde gshegs rigs kyi seng gdong thugs dam bskang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phyir// rin chen rigs kyi seng gdong thugs dam bskang*// khams gsum skye 'gro dbang du bsdu bya'i phyir// padma'i rigs kyi seng gdong thugs dam bskang*// mthun phyogs spel zhing mi mthun phyogs gzhom phyir// las kyi rigs kyi seng gdong thugs dam bskang*// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med yongs rje mo// seng gdong rab 'jigs khros ma'i thugs dam bskang*// gdug can dgra bgegs 'dul phyir drag mo'i tshul// seng gdong rngam zhal can ma'i thugs dam bskang*// dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i srog gcod phyir// gri gug 'bar ba 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang*// byad ma'i snying khrag dron mo 'thung ba'i phyir// thod phrag lcang lo can ma'i thugs dam bskang*// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug kha sbyor phyir// kha ṭwāṃ ga la 'khyud ma'i thugs dam bskang*// bgegs rigs thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag bya'i phyir// zhabs kyis ro snying bsnun ma'i thugs dam bskang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las lhun grub phyir// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*// legs nyes stong 'dzin dam tshig rjes skyong pa// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ci yang ston// mthu ldan 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// bka' nyan las byed sprul pa yang sprul gyi// ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang*// bskang ngo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam gnyen po bskang*// bshags so bdag rgyud nyes ltung mtha' dag bshags// bzlog go mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog

/stsol lo dngos grub ma lus deng 'dir stsol// bskul lo dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la bskul// mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// bdag cag 'khor bcas byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// thub dbang bstan pa'i dpal du 'gyur ba dang*// ma gyur 'gro ba'i don kun 'grub pa dang*// sa dang lam gyi rim pa kun bgrod nas// mkha' 'gro nyid kyi go 'phang thob par mdzod// bzhi pa mthol shing bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ye shes dbyings kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro ma// khro zhal rngam pa seng ge'i gdong can ma// khyed thugs dbyings las g.yo ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag sogs sems can don la dgongs su gsol// thog med dus nas tha ma da lta'i bar// ma rig 'khrul pa'i nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// so sor thar dang byang sems gsang sngags kyi// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags// dbang bzhi'i dam tshig tshul bzhin ma bsrungs dang*// bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor thun bzhir ma bsgoms dang*// mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dus su ma mchod pas// dam tshig nyams chag gyur pa mthol lo bshags// rang lus mkha' 'gror ma gsal mthol lo bshags// sngags tshig dag par ma bzlas= /rang sems mkha' 'gror ma rtogs mthol= /mkha' 'gro'i yon tan ma shes mthol= /mkha' 'gro'i phrin las ma bsgrubs mthol lo= /mdor na lus ngag yid kyi sgo rnams nas// thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ci mchis pa// mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// zhes so// lnga pa bzlas pa bya ba ni// mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad la dmigs te rtsa sngags ci nus bzlas la/ hūm̐ bhyoḥrgyal ba kun yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// singha mu kha'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams// dgyes par bskyed pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// gang bcol phrin las 'di dag 'grub par mdzod// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin rnams kyi bzhed pa chos bzhin 'grub// bar chad kun zhi sku tshe mchog tu ring*// phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// lus ngag yid kyi bar chad kun zhi zhing*// bsam pa'i don rnams chos dang mthun par 'grub// 'di phyi bde ba'i lam bzang 'grub par mdzod// bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gros brtser dgongs shing*// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs zhugs// byang chub sems kyi nus pa cher brtan pas// theg chen lam la g.yo ba med par mdzod// dbang las thob pa'i dam tshig rnam par dag

/rim gnyis bsgom pas lam gyi yon tan 'phel// zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams thogs med 'grub// mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzod// sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang g.yog bcas kyi// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen tshang ba dang*// bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams la dad gus kyi// dge ba rgya cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// rnam pa kun tu mi dge'i las spang zhing*// dge ba'i las la kun tu brtson pa dang*// theg pa chen po'i lam la rab zhugs nas// bla med byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes pas phrin las bcol/ drug pa bsgral las bya ba ni/ mdun du liṅga dngos su yod na ling khebs bsal/ dngos su med pa'i tshe gtor ma'i 'og gi liṅga la dmigs te/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ nag po yongs su gyur pa las gnam lcags las grub pa'i gshin rje'i khang sgrom gru gsum pa/ kha dog cing gting zab pa/ steng nas dug mtshon ser char 'bab pa/ 'og nas khrag nad rlangs pa 'phyur ba/ gsod gcod nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ gshin rje nag po'i kha gdangs lta bur zin nas thar pa med pa'i ro dong nag po/ de'i nang du nṛ yongs su gyur pa las gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad kyi ngo bo/ liṅga gcer bu lus rid cing nyam thag pa/ gdong pa mchi ma'i rgyun gyis g.yogs pa/ bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag cing*/ mdze dang phol mig du mas btab pa/ rkang lag lcags kyi sgrog tu chud pa/ mgon skyabs bral bas skrag cing 'dar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ ces brjod/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul/ de dag las rang dang 'dra ba'i pho nya las mkhan khro 'khrug rngam pa lag na lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu sogs mtshon cha thogs pa stong gsum khyab pa 'phros/

gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma gang du gnas pa nas rang dbang med par bkug ste/ gzugs brnyan la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ dzaḥrje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i sogs nas/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang dmod pa/ bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra/ dge 'dun gyi spyi dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ bsam sbyor ngan pa rtsom par byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs/ rbad 'dre rbod gtong*/ byad zor rtsub pa/ snga dgra byas pa/ phyi dgra shom pa/ da dgra sdang zhing gnod pa/ phod btsugs pa/ do bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma gang yin pa de dag stong gsum 'jig rten/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla gang du gnas kyang*/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la ming dang rus su smos pa/ gzugs dang rtags su byas pa'i dgra bgegs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig phob cig ces dang*/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥsogs yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i mthar/ sarba sha trūn ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes dang*/ oṃ badzra yaṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa biṃ/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes pa phyag rgya dang bcas te lan gsum gyis dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang du bya/ slar yang lha dbye'i ched du/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs nas/ do bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma gang yin pa de dag thams cad srung skyob byed pa'i lha dang phyes shig stong grogs byed pa'i lha dang phyes shig pha lha dang phyes shig ma lha dang phyes shig zhang lha dang phyes shig srog lha dang phyes shig yul lha dang phyes shig srung 'khor gyi lha dang phyes shig

yi dam gyi lha dang phyes shig nus mthu bskyed pa'i lha dang phyes shig aḥkaḥsogs rtsa sngags la sarba sha trū na sarb+ba de wā uṅgha ṭa ya phaṭa/ ces brjod pas dgra bo mgon skyabs kyi lha thams cad kyis spangs par bsam/ de nas gnang ba zhu zhing drag po'i phrin las su bskul ba ni/ gtor chung zhig kyang bran te/ gser skyems nam mkhar gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum// snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi bdag gnyen po rnams// gser skyems mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la// mngon spyod las la phrag dog ma mdzad par// bstan dgra spangs nas bdag gi dpung gnyen mdzod// bhyoḥchos dbyings rnam dag nam mkha'i klong yangs su// rab 'jigs dur khrod chen pos yongs su bskor// chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mo sku bzhengs shig /drag mo seng ge'i gdong can sku bzhengs shig /rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sku bzhengs shig /gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro sku bzhengs shig /sprul pa yang sprul tshogs rnams sku bzhengs shig /pho nya las mkhan tshogs rnams sku bzhengs shig /sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// drag po'i phrin las bskul la da tshur gson// skye 'gro'i bde skyid bstan la rag las mod// bstan dgra btang snyoms su la mngon spyod brtsam// de slad bstan pa nyams par byed pa'i dgra// bla ma dkon mchog dbu 'phang dmod pa'i dgra// sems can yongs la rnam 'tshe'i dgra dang bgegs// bdag cag byang chub sgrub po 'khor bcas la// gnod cing bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dgra byung na// mthu chen mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i thugs// rgyud nas bskul ba'i dgos pa mi chung grang*// de phyir drag mo khros pa'i skur sprul ma// bdud dang dgra bgegs dam nyams tshar gcod ma// khyed kyi thugs dam gnyen po dus la bab// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma'i tshogs// 'di dag khyed kyis myur du bsgral ba'i 'os// da ltar ma bsgral thugs dam bcas pa 'gal// de slad bdag gis bskul ba'i phrin las 'di// da lta nyid du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob yon sbyor gyis// thar pa thams cad mkhyen lam sgrub pa'i bgegs// gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs kyi rigs// myur du khug la bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod// dam nyams dgra bgegs las ngan sdig can 'di'i// gnam gyi 'ju thag dkar po steng nas chod// sa yi rten phur nag po 'og nas phyungs// mgon skyob byed pa'i lha srung kun dang phrol// lus la dug nad mtshon cha'i char pa phob// ngag nas smre sngags lhang lhang 'don du chug

/yid kyis ting 'dzin bsgom pa rmugs su chug /rnam shes skye med mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang bsres// sha khrag rus pa lhag med tshogs su rol// rigs brgyud nye 'brel 'khor g.yog rtsad nas phyungs// yul gzhis zas nor dus mtha'i rlung la skur// thal ba'i rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod// phyin chad dgra bgegs byad ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// bdag la glags lta'i skabs rnyed med par mdzod// bsam ngan gdug rtsub sdig pa'i rgyun bcad de// thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'gyur bar mdzod// mdor na sdang zhing gdug sems ldan pa 'di// lo dang zla ba'i yun tshad ma 'gyangs bar// zhag dang za ma'i dus mtshams da lta nyid// bsad cing bsgral nas rnam shes dbyings su sgrol// ces bskul zhing*/ de nas phur pa lag tu thogs la/ hūm̐ nga ni dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// sprul pa'i las byed seng ge'i gdong can ma// ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso// dam nyams byad ma'i srog gi gshed ma ste// lag na gdug can gsod pa'i phur pa thogs// sku stod khro chen 'bar ba rngams shing brjid// sku smad gnam lcags phur bu zur gsum dbal// reg pas gcod pa'i ye shes mtshon rnon 'di// dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du btab tsam gyis// las ngan rgyun bcad lus ngan rdul du rlog /hūm̐ dgra bgegs byad ma'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi// nus mthu bkrag mdangs bsod nams lhag ma bcas// 'bru gsum sa bon gzugs gyur bdag la thim// bdag gi sgo gsum mthu stobs gzi brjid rgyas// oṃ āḥhūm̐ nṛ dzaḥzhes dang*/ phur bu'i dbu gtsug gis rang gi gnas gsum du gtugs te/ slar yang aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥsogs dang*/ badzra kī li kī la ya dgra bo byad ma'i srog snying la mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥrbad rbad e sa bhyo rbad/ ces mang du bzla zhing*/ dgra bo'i snying gar drag tu btab pas tshe'i rgyun bcad/

rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rten dang bcas pa rdul du brlag par bsam/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor te 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ me tog gi char 'bebs/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pa dang bcas te skad cig nyid la mi bskyod pa'i zhing du thogs pa med par gshegs par bsam/ phaṭa drag po brjod cing mig gyen du blta/ mthar bsgral bya sgrol byed bsgral ba'i thabs thams cad rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /de nas ling ro zhal bstab bya ba ni/ hūm̐ mi bzad sdig pa'i las la ches rngams pa'i// dug gsum gong bur gyur pa'i bdud dgra rnams// skye med dbyings su sbyor sgrol bgyis pa yi// sha rus ri bo khrag zhag rgya mtshor gyur// mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mo'i zhal du bstabs// drag mo seng ge'i gdong can zhal du bstabs// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i zhal du bstabs// gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstabs// sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyi zhal du bstabs// pho nya las mkhan tshogs kyi zhal du bstabs// zhal du bstabs pa kha kha khā hi hoḥ /dgyes par rol nas dngos grub stsol cig gu// bdun pa bzlog pa la/ sngar gyi ling ro yod pa de dang bcas pa'i gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa bran la/ 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ 'dir zor byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir dmigs pa dkyus ltar dang*/ hūm̐ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i sogs nas gzi brjid 'bar gyur cig ces pa'i bar brjod do// bzlog pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid seng ge'i gdong can mar gsal ba'i snying gar rang dang bsrung bya sba ba man ngag ltar dang*/ bdag mdun gyi lha tshogs thams cad dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma la shin tu khros pa'i nyams dang ldan pas hūm̐ zhes drag tu brjod pa'i shangs nas rlung chen drag tu g.yos pa dang mnyam du/

sku'i cha dang ral pa'i gseb la sogs pa nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ de rnams kyis bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgo gsum gyi bar chad/ chag che nyam nga*/ mi nad phyugs nad/ nad sri 'chi sri/ rmi ngan ltas ngan gyi 'bras bu la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad thal ba rdul du bshig ro ma rnams kyang dus mtha'i 'thor rlung gis gtor ba bzhin du rjes med du gtor/ des zhi bar ma gyur pa pha rol gyi byad gtad drag sbyor gyi mthu dang nus pa thams cad byad mkhan rang gi gshed du bab cing tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad/ thams cad kyi zhal nas bhyoḥbhyoḥbazlog bzlog gi nga ro drag pos 'jig rten gyi khams g.yo bar nus pa tsam du yod par bsams la/ gyer bsgom lhan cig pas 'di skad do// hūm̐ rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i tshogs// gcig bsdus gdug pa tshar gcod seng ge'i gdong*// sku mdog mun ltar gnag cing seng ge'i zhal// stong gsum dgra la rngam pas rab tu gdangs// mche rnon gtsigs pas sa gsum 'byung po bsngangs// ljags dmar bar snang g.yo bas dgra khrag gzhib// spyan gsum dmar zlum ldog pas log 'dren gzir// shangs nas rlung 'tshubs dgra bgegs thal bar gtor// ag tshom gseb nas khro chu'i zhun ma 'thor// smin 'khyog me yi tsha tshas bgegs dpung bsreg /ral pa sprugs pa'i khrod nas khro chung tshogs// sprul pas bsrung bzlog phrin las ci yang sgrub// zhal nas bhyo bzlog hūm̐ phaṭa 'jigs rung sgras// pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog cing bsgyur// mi sdug chas brgyan sku las mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// sprul pas stong gsum bstan dgra'i dpung tshogs bcom// rgyal rnams sku gsung yon tan phrin las kyi// rang bzhin rigs bzhi seng ge'i gdong can ma// ma mo mkha' 'gro sprul pa yang sprul bcas// rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum// rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas bsrung ba'i tshe// bdud sdes mi phyed srung ba'i gur khang brtan// gdug pa tshar gcod las la mngags pa'i tshe// mthu stobs thogs med gnam lcags thog ltar myur// dgra la bab na dgra srog hur thum 'phrog

/bgegs la bab na bgegs dpung dbyings su btul// gdon la bab na gdon rkang drung nas 'byin// byad mar bab na lha srung bdud du 'bebs// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa// las la 'gyed pa'i mkha' 'gro seng gdong can// 'khor bcas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// de ring bzlog bsgyur phrin las grub par mdzod// ces pas bzlog pa'i las la bskul nas bzlog pa dngos ni/ bhyoḥdapa' mo rab 'jigs seng ge'i gdong can ma// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang shugs 'gror bcas// gnas gsum ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dang*// sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa tshur dgongs la// deng 'dir bstan pa'i bshad sgrub spel ba dang*// sems can phan 'dogs bde skyid bsgrub pa dang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas rnams// chos dang srid pa'i bde 'byor bsgrub pa la// sdang sems gdug sems dug chus cher myos pa'i// gnod byed ban bon mu stegs gang yin gyis// mnan gzir byad gtad ngan pa gang brtsams pa// byad mkhan de de'i gshed du bzlog cing bsgyur// bdud dang gshin rje srin po ma mo btsan// rgyal 'gong 'byung po dam sri the'u rang sogs// snang srid lha srin dregs byed rbad bskul gyi// nyer 'tshe thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// srin par kun rtog rdzing bu rnyog byed cing*// bar chad 'jug pa'i pho nya dang po'i 'phrin// ltas ngan ye 'drog rmi lam ngan pa'i rigs// 'bras bu 'byin nus med par bzlog cing bsgyur// gnam lo zla ba zhag dus spar sme yi// 'byung khams mi mthun gcod 'dral las byung ba'i// keg 'phrang sri langs na shi dur zhugs kyi// chag che nyam nga bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// gdon bgegs 'byung tshogs 'khrugs pa'i kha yi rlangs// rlung mkhris bad kan ldan 'dus las gyur pa'i// mi nad phyugs nad yams nad 'go ba'i rigs// mi 'byung byung ba bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// sngon las ngan dang glo bur rkyen byung gi

/dus min 'chi bar 'gyur ba ji snyed dang*// mi nor gang stangs rigs chad rgud pa sogs// skal ngan thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// gzhan gyi dpal 'byor dbrog la ches rngam pa'i// dgra jag chom rkun dmag 'khrug 'jigs pa dang*// kha smras rtsod pa rgyal po'i chad pa sogs// dngangs skrag 'jigs pa thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur// bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// snga dgra byas dang da dgra snying la bcang*// kha dgra khyi ltar zug pa'i sdang dgra rnams// sa 'og sa steng sa bla gar bros kyang*// rengs par khug la bzung dang bcing brdeg gtubs// bsad bcad bsgral nas rnam shes chos dbyings bstim// ji ltar bcol pa'i phrin las sgrubs mdzod cig /ces brjod cing rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu lha srin sde brgyad mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byad kha rbod gtong thams cad byad ma gnod byed kyi steng du e sa bhyoḥbhyoḥbazlog bzlog ces bzlas/ bzlog pa bsdus pa ni/ bhyoḥdapa' mo rab 'jigs seng ge'i gdong can ma// cho 'phrul bsam yas mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas kyis// mthu dang nus pa rdzu 'phrul cher bskyed la// bzlog par bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// mi dang mi min su dang gang gi'ang rung*// ngan sngags zor kha mnan gtad 'khrul 'khor sogs// ngan par brtsams pa'i bsam sbyor mtha' dag ni// byad mkhan de nyid rang la bzlog par mdzod// nam mkha' gang ba lha yi cho 'phrul dang*// bar snang khyab pa'i gnyan gyi gdug rtsub dang*// sa gzhi gang ba'i klu yi gnod pa rnams// thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod// sngon gyi las la dbang bas sna drangs pa'i// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i gnod pa yi// nad dang gdon dang bar chad ci mchis pa// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzlog cing bsgyur bar mdzod// byang chub bsgrub pa'i gegs su gyur pa yi// 'gal rkyen tshogs dang mi mthun thog tu babs// bsam la bar du gcod pa thams cad kyang*// khyed kyi nus pas myur du bzlog tu gsol// bdag la sems pa'i gang zag thams cad dang*// sbyin pa'i bdag po phan sems ldan pa la// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs// ma lus bzlog cing bsgral nas med par mdzod// mdor na bsam ngan sbyor rtsub gang brtsams pa// de dag de ring nyid la bzlog pa dang*// nam mkha' sprin ltar dengs par mdzad nas kyang*// 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang rtsa sngags bzlog sham can bzla'o// de yan chad zhag grags ci rigs par bya'o// nyi ma snga ma rnams su de nas thun gtor skyong ba sogs la 'jug go

/brgyad pa zor bskul ba ni/ nyi ma rjes ma'i nyin gtor chen 'gro phyogs su zhal bsgyur la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ni gtor ma dang tha mi dad par lhar bskyed pa yin na'ang*/ 'dir mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du shes par byas nas rdul tshon mi bsdu bar rjes chog gi mchod yul du gzhag yul gyi gzhi bdag la gtor ma btang la stong grogs bcol/ gser skyems nam mkha' la gtor zhing 'di skad gyer ro// hūm̐ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad dang*// yul lha sa bdag bcas pa rnams// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bstan dgra rdul du brlag bya'i phyir// de ring mngon spyod brtsams pa la// ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par// bdag gi rgyab brten dpung sgrogs spyon// yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'dis// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra byas// dkon mchog gsum la skur pa btab// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra byas// rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra byed// de bas bsgral ba'i zhing gyur 'di// las ngan rgyun chags 'gog phyir du// myur du bsgral la gnang ba stsol// de nas bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro 'khor tshogs sprul pa yang sprul grangs med pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi dregs pa'i sde tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te khro 'khrug rngam pas dgra bo'i phyogs su chas par bsams la/ hūm̐ nga ni dus gsum bde gshegs kyi// sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong*// ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dgra bgegs byad ma'i srog gi gshed// srid gsum gnas na nga dbang che// las la mi 'khol 'ga' yang med// nga yi gtor zor gnyen po 'di// steng gi lha la mi 'phang ngo*// 'og gi klu la mi 'phang ngo*// bar gyi gnyan la mi 'phang ngo*// dgra bgegs byad ma bsgral ba'i phyir// drag po zor gyi las byed do// bhyoḥshar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// dri za'i dmag tshogs grangs med bcas// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// gtor zor gnyen po'i lam yangs phyes// dmag dpung bskyod la ru mtshon phyor// zor sna dgra bo'i yul du drangs// bhyoḥlho phyogs rgyal chen 'phags skyes po// gshin rje'i dmag tshogs grangs med bcas// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// gtor zor gnyen po'i lam yangs phyes// dmag dpung bskyod la ru mtshon phyor// zor sna dgra bo'i yul du drangs// bhyoḥnub phyogs rgyal chen mig mi bzang*// klu gdon dmag tshogs grangs med bcas// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes zor rnams gang du 'phen pa'i sa der spyan drangs la/ gtor chen mi lpags sam gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi pags pa'i steng du bzhugs su gsol la/ nang mchod dang chus bran la/ las su gtad pa ni/ thog mar phud mchod 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa yon tan kun gyi dngos// dbang brgyud byin rlabs gdams pa stsal drin che// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// rdo rje 'chang chen dpa' mo seng ge'i gdong*// dgra las rnam rgyal rdo rje gdan pa che// don yod rdo rje ba ri lo tsā ba// brtse chen snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// bsod nams rtse mo rje btsun grags rgyal mtshan// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang brag phug bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// kun dga' bkra shis ngang tshul bzang po can// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan blo gros bzang po dang*// mkhyen rab chos rje lo chen chos skyong bzang*// sa skya lo tsā'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dkon mchog lhun grub dkon mchog dpal ldan dang*// shar chen kun bkras sher 'byung kun dga' legs// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// bkra shis lhun grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dpa' mo seng ge'i gdong can rigs bzhis mtshon// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi sde tshogs bcas// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad dang*// rang lus lha yi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gur gyi mgon po gdong bzhi ldan pas mtshon// bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho thams cad dang*// gnas chen yul chen dur khrod cher nyul ba'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// bstan ma bcu gnyis gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang*// 'gro drug lha ru gsal la oṃ āḥhūm̐// mchod yul dgyes nas las kyi dngos grub stsol// sbyin yul tshim nas gnod sems spong gyur cig

/ces dang*/ rang gis kyang myangs la aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥsogs brjod do// de nas rnga tshigs rol mor bcas pas 'di skad gyer ro// hūm̐ rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong*// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// seng gdong drag mo zor la bzhengs// rigs bzhi'i drag mo zor la bzhengs// ye shes mkha' 'gro zor la bzhengs// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro zor la bzhengs// mkha' 'gro bye 'bum zor la bzhengs// sprul pa yang sprul zor la bzhengs// bka' srung dam can zor la bzhengs// gtsang ris dpal mgon zor la bzhengs// lha srin sde brgyad zor la bzhengs// yul lha gzhi bdag zor la bzhengs// bzhengs shig zor gyi mthu dpung bskyed// kun kyang zor thogs las la sgrims// mthu stobs dus mtha'i rlung ltar skyed// dpung tshogs nyi zer rdul ltar spros// gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar skyed// mtshon char brag ri bsnyil ltar phobs// 'jigs rung nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs// bstan dgra dam nyams yul du rgyug /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// de nas rdo rje zor 'dzin gyis zor chung phyag tu thogs nas thams cad kyi ngag tu/ hūm̐ bstan dgra byad ma bsgral ba'i phyir// drag po'i gtor zor 'bar ba 'phen// hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥbhyoḥmā ra ya'i// 'ur sgras stong gsum 'jig rten 'dar// thun zor rdo rje'i ser chen 'bebs// mtshe zor ral gri'i nags ltar 'khrugs// nyungs zor drag po'i char ltar phab// rdo zor gnam lcags sgyogs ltar 'phen// mda' zor rdugs med thog ltar rgyu// khrag zor zangs zhun bu yug 'tshubs// rtsang zor spu gri'i so ltar gzings// gtor zor dug nad mtshon cha'i char// gang la bab pa brlag byed 'di// bstan dgra dam nyams steng du 'phen// mi ro rdza ltar nyid du chugs// mi khrag mtsho ltar 'khyil du chugs// mā ra ya'i las mdzod cig

/ces dang*/ sgrub grogs rnams kyis drag rol rgyun ring bya zhing*/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyis gtor ma/ thun/ mtshe/ nyungs/ rdo/ mda'/ khrag zor rnams 'phang*/ de nas zor chen lag tu thogs la/ bhyoḥmathu ldan mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs// pho nya las mkhan bcas pa rnams// bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul// rbad do gnod byed thog tu rbad// yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'di'i// yul gzhis sgo nor nad dug mtshon cha'i phung por gyur pa mdun du brub khung gi nang du dgra bo'i mi nor yul mkhar dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du dmigs pa'i steng du brgyabs pas rdul phra rab tu brlag par bsams la/ 'gro dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod// bdag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams kun// yid bzhin du ni 'grub par mdzod// mchod do mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas mchod// bzhes shig rdzas dang mchod gtor bzhes// bskul lo phrin las rnam bzhi bskul// mdzod cig dus la ma g.yel mdzod// ces dang*/

yi ge bcu bzhi pa bsad sngags sham can bzlas la gtor ma dgra phyogs su btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ rjes chog mchod bstod 'dod don zhus// yig brgya nongs bshags brtan bzhugs gshegs// rjes ma'i gshegs gsol las rjes bsdu// rang bsrung bsngo ba bkra shis brjod// ces pa ltar/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos te/ mdun bskyed gyi lha la mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la 'dod don gsol ba btab mthar/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ sku rten dang nyi ma sngon ma la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bcas pa la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sogs nas oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā'i bar gyis brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron rnams dang*/ nyi ma rjes ma'i nyin rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa dang rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod cing bsam/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /seng ge'i gdong can 'grub gyur nas// zhes dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i zhes sogs dang*/ bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor du bcas// bar chad dgra 'dre'i 'khrul snang ji snyed pa// stong nyid snying rje'i 'khor lo 'dis dral te// gnod bya gnod byed bde la sbyor gyur cig /ces pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam gang shes brjod/ rdul tshon bsdus nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir dri zhim po'i chus byugs la/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgyas par brjod cing phyogs kun tu me tog gi sil mas gtor bar bya'o// 'dir smras pa/

rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i tshogs// yid srubs byed pos sprul pa'i byad mkhan gyi// nus mthu thams cad de de'i gshed phab nas// gdug pa 'dul byed seng ge'i gdong can ma// der brten bstan dgra gsod byed las kyi mtshon// ba ri lo tsā las brgyud sa skya pa'i// gser chos gdams pa'i gtor bzlog brgyud pa'i rim// las rab gces pa'i mdzod du sbas pa'i don// gang de'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang gtor bzlog bcas// byed po ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje zhes// mdo sngags chos kyi 'dren byed dkyus ring phyir// de nyid tshad ldan gzhung du nges mod kyi// mdun bskyed lha dang gdab las bzlog zor sogs// yongs su ma rdzogs dpa' bo go mtshon gyis// dben pa g.yul du zhugs ltar blo dman dag /lag bstar ma bzod gyi nar lus pa gang*// gang tshe rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// phrin las mi nub rgyun phyir gtam gyi sgo// phye ba'i sing nas rus pa'i ke sa ras// ming tshig yi ge'i gad mo 'byin snyam byed// drag sbyor yan lag rdzogs pa khyab 'jug gi /mtshon cha'i 'khor los bde legs bdud rtsi'i bcud// brku 'dod sdang dgra byad ma'i sgra gcan gzugs// nus mthur bcas pa'i mgrin pa gcod nus byas// rig sngags 'chang ba mkhas pa'i 'phong skyen gyis// shes rab snying rje'i mda' gzhu legs sbyar nas// gnod byed dgra bgegs bden bral mgo bo brgya// cig car bregs pa'i nus mthu 'di la rdzogs// tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dge ba bdud bzhi las// rnam rgyal thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang nas// khams gsum skye 'gro tha dad blor 'tsham pa'i// zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor phyir bsngo// zhes gser chos lugs kyi seng ge'i gdong can sngon mo'i gtor bzlog gi phrin las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhas btsun bla ma rdo rje 'dzin dbang bsod nams dbang phyug pa'i gsung gis bstan dang 'gro ba'i gegs sel du dmigs pa'i thugs bskyed kyis snga phyir bskul ngor/

mkhan chen ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang gtor bzlog gi las gzhung la gzhir byas/ de dag tu ma tshang ba'i brgyud pa'i bzhed srol dang gtor bzlog gi phrin las la kha 'gengs dgos pa'i rigs rnams gsar bskrun dang bcas te lag tu blang bde bar/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen pos legs par gsungs pa'i bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la btags pa'i ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i rnam par gnon pa'i lo'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi grags pa'i mu khyud phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par grub par bgyis pa bi dza yantu// //mngon spyod las sbyor la dgos pa'i zor rdzas kyi nus pa bskyed pa'i byin rlabs ni/ rang dang mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi drag mo seng gdong*/ 'khor gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro/ sprul pa yang sprul/ chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas mthu stobs nus pa thams cad 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa'i tshogs du ma dang sprul pa'i las mkhan khro bo khro mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ zor rdzas rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas/ gang la dmigs pa skad cig nyid la thogs pa med par 'joms pa'i nus stobs dang ldan pa gyur par bsams la/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// zor rdzas 'di rnams bstan dgra byad ma'i rigs// gang la bsnun 'phral tshar gcod las byed pa'i// dug nad thog gi nus pa da skyed cig /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs kyis// zor rdzas 'di rnams bstan dgra byad ma'i rigs// gang la bsnun 'phral tshar gcod las byed pa'i// dug nad thog gi nus pa da skyed cig
